canada.title: Cycling advocate hopes Winnipeg's next mayor doesn't backpedal on commitments
canada.summary: A bike advocate is hoping whoever is elected as Winnipeg's mayor builds off existing momentum on the future of cycling and pedestrian infrastructure.

canada.title: Winnipegger facing extradition over COVID relief fraud, money laundering allegations
canada.summary: A Winnipeg man is facing extradition after U.S. authorities accused him of defrauding a pandemic-era relief program of hundreds of thousands of dollars.

canada.title: Yukon photographer captures footage of caribou carrying dead rival in its antlers
canada.summary: WARNING: This story contains graphic images of wildlife. Wildlife photographer Peter Mather said he was “shocked” to find a pair of bull caribou with antlers locked together, one of them dead, in the mountains south of Whitehorse earlier this month. He captured what happened as other wildlife fed off the carcass, still attached to the other bull.

canada.title: New study sheds light on sled dogs' short legs, but experts say this is already well known
canada.summary: A new study shows sled dogs have shorter back legs than other dogs by six per cent, but experts in the sled dog world say this is already widely documented and discussed.

canada.title: Free labour movement not something Canada and EU considering in new pact: ambassador
canada.summary: Negotiations toward a new transatlantic pact between Canada and the European Union don’t include discussions for a full-scale free labour movement, but something more focused, Canada’s EU ambassador said ahead of the Canada-EU summit later this week in Montreal.

canada.title: Why the economic allure of shale gas has Holt confronting political ghosts
canada.summary: In 2023, Susan Holt said, “New Brunswickers have made it clear, they made it clear that they do not want to take on the risk of hydraulic fracturing." Now the province is testing the waters with a five month review of the fracking moratorium. What changed?

canada.title: Holt Liberals cutting committee oversight in half
canada.summary: The Holt Liberals are cutting in half the amount of time a committee of MLAs spends scrutinizing the spending of government departments, agencies and Crown corporations.

canada.title: N.S. woman refused to comply with phone scammer, so would-be fraudster swatted her house
canada.summary: A Truro-area woman says she is shaken and terrified after a would-be fraudster sent heavily armed police from two different departments to her home over the weekend.

canada.title: Family relieved as NLHS reverses decision to terminate St. John’s man’s social support
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador Health Services is walking back a termination of support that left one man fearing he’d become homeless, following reporting by CBC News.

canada.title: Outreach workers in N.L. see more people turn to tents amid housing crunch
canada.summary: When approaching people sleeping in tents, housing outreach co-ordinator Christine Byrne’s mission is to make resources available when they feel the most out of reach. Her job has become much busier with time.

canada.title: As scandals mount, data shows drop in street-level experience among Montreal police
canada.summary: Newly obtained internal data reveals a drop in experience levels at Station 39, where a group of officers were suspended this summer for alleged hateful and discriminatory acts. Experts and former police officers say a lack of veteran presence among patrol officers can lead to problems.

canada.title: High school west of Montreal boosts security as it struggles with student fights, unrest
canada.summary: A series of incidents and fights at a high school in Pincourt, Que., west of Montreal, has shaken parents and students since the start of the school year. Earlier this month, the school had security cameras installed, and added security guards.

canada.title: Hamilton mayor-elect Keanin Loomis says he's ready to bring a new approach to city hall
canada.summary: Hamilton voters delivered big change to city hall in Monday's election, putting Keanin Loomis in the mayor's chair and bringing eight new city councillors to the table.

canada.title: B.C. NDP's defeat reflected in low voter turnout: political scientists
canada.summary: Political scientists say record-low voter turnout reflected a sharp drop in support for the B.C. NDP, paving the way for the party's humbling defeat by the B.C. Conservatives.

canada.summary: First two-goal game. First three-point game. First on-ice Griddy.

canada.title: Raymond completes Red Wings’ rally with SO winner
canada.summary: Lucas Raymond scored the shootout winner and had a pair of assists in regulation time as the Detroit Red Wings posted a 4-3 victory over the Edmonton Oilers on Monday.
